title: New law: National Voter Registration Act of 1993 (Public Law 103-31)
summary: H.R. 2 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-31 on 1993-05-20.

title: New law: A bill to authorize the conduct and development of NAEP assessments for fiscal year 1994. (Public Law 103-33)
summary: S. 801 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-33 on 1993-05-25.

title: New law: A bill to authorize the construction of a memorial on Federal land in the District of Columbia or its environs to honor members of the Armed Forces who served in World War II and to commemorate United States participation in that conflict. (Public Law 103-32)
summary: S. 214 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-32 on 1993-05-25.

title: New law: A bill to provide for the rehabilitation of historic structures within the Sandy Hook Unit of Gateway National Recreation Area in the State of New Jersey, and for other purposes. (Public Law 103-26)
summary: S. 328 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-26 on 1993-05-03.

title: New law: A bill to revise the boundaries of the George Washington Birthplace National Monument, and for other purposes. (Public Law 103-25)
summary: S. 326 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-25 on 1993-05-03.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the weeks beginning April 18, 1993, and April 17, 1994, each as "National Organ and Tissue Donor Awareness Week". (Public Law 103-30)
summary: S.J.Res. 66 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-30 on 1993-05-07.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the week beginning April 25, 1993, as "National Crime Victims' Right Week". (Public Law 103-29)
summary: S.J.Res. 62 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-29 on 1993-05-06.

summary: S.J.Res. 30 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-27 on 1993-05-03.

title: New law: Designating June 1, 1993, through June 7, 1993, as a "Week for the National Observance of the Fiftieth Anniversary of World War II". (Public Law 103-34)
summary: H.J.Res. 80 of the 103rd Congress became Public Law 103-34 on 1993-05-31.

title: New law: To authorize the President to proclaim the last Friday of April 1993 as "National Arbor Day". (Public Law 103-28)
